_note: Series and recurring devices per brand, from research/<brand>/concepts.md and extras.json, every ad id listed. Read by compute.py --series.

A.name: Openings that run down the MBA
A.note: 11 of 30 ads open by calling the MBA or college outdated, dead, not enough or its graduates underused; 3 of them say "outdated" and "unemployable".

A.name: Same footage in several shapes
A.note: Four ideas run in two shapes each (16:9 with 9:16, 4:5 or square); some cuts drop or swap the first sentence.

A.name: Named companies in the story
A.note: Mokobara is spoken or captioned in three ideas (8 ads); the timeline film names Sequoia, McKinsey, Zomato, Razorpay and Apple (5 ads), spoken only.

A.name: 50 lakh in three meanings
A.note: 50 lakh is a brand's revenue, a D2C aim or a funding offer to a student, with no source or student named.

A.name: One interview closing line, three scripts
A.note: "If I was a student ... like an SSB today, I do think that exposure would have helped" closes three scripts; none labels who speaks.

A.name: Early bird date after the date
A.note: Four ads started 17 to 19 Nov still show "Early Bird Deadline 1st November 2026", two in the headline and two on the end card.

B.name: The Ascend shoot, cut into six ideas
B.note: One interview session gives six different answers across 32 ads, each with its own headline naming Ascend, while the speech never does.

B.name: Quit-your-job reassurance cards
B.note: Image ads that say you need not quit your job: "You Don't Have to Quit Your Job to Learn to Build" alone is 15 ads, all Ascend.

B.name: The 200-person cohort call
B.note: 13 ads share the text "Mesa is selecting 200 ambitious individuals" over four videos, nine of them over the 38-second cohort call itself.

B.name: One investor recording, two edits
B.note: An outside investor on a podcast set: one cut opens on "200 plus startups", the other on "every student has to sell 5 lakhs in 8 weeks".

B.name: Graduate outcomes, in figures or named alumni
B.note: Full-time PGP ads that state a graduate outcome: 100% placements, an average salary upwards of 25 lakhs, 57.5% in early startups, 50 to 60% rises (14 videos); 71% career pivot, 58% founder-facing, 2.8x, or a named graduate's new role (16 image ads). The figures are not sourced and do not agree.

B.name: Undergraduate podcast-mic set
B.note: One speaker at a studio microphone tells three student stories; students are talked about and never speak.

B.name: Founding cohort and early bird cards
B.note: Ascend image ads that invite people to the founding online cohort; one idea names the early bird close, 26 November 2026.

B.name: The borrowed-clip selfie
B.note: One 105-second video with a known investor's stage clip, re-sent in four shapes under two ad texts.
